text: カギを　さがして　いるのか　さあ　しらないねえ…

structure.jp: カギを　さがして　いるのか
structure.en: so you're looking for a key?

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.span: さがして　いるのか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end says the speaker has just worked out what is going on and is checking it. さがして　いるのか = 'so you're looking for it, are you?'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says the action is going on now. さがして　いる = 'are looking for'.
